watchlist.title: Anthropic embeds METR evaluators with employee-like access
watchlist.summary: Anthropic says six METR employees now have company hardware, office space, and access broadly comparable to its internal risk-assessment teams, with publication rights subject to predefined redaction categories.
watchlist.what_changed: The evaluator relationship moved from external review of published risk reports to an embedded-access model with a three-tier framework, while METR has not yet published findings from the new arrangement.

evidence.rationale: Anthropic documents the access model and publication terms, but the source is the company being evaluated and no assessment from the embedded team has been published.

signal.rationale: The access model could strengthen frontier-model assurance, but its engineering value depends on the scope and evidence in independent published findings.

deduplication.canonical_event: Anthropic begins an embedded evaluator arrangement with METR in October 2026.

watchlist.reason: The announcement defines an access and governance process, not an evaluation result; selecting it now would require inferring assurance value before independent findings exist.
promote_when: METR publishes its first assessment under the embedded-access arrangement
the report documents methods, access limits, findings, and Anthropic's response
